category: モデルの構築・デプロイ・監視
title: Input Changes During Inference
prompt: In SageMaker real-time inference, I want to be notified if the distribution of input features changes from the distribution during training. The correct labels are not available yet.

choices.text: Measure only the model's accuracy directly
choices.explanation: Direct measurement requires the correct labels corresponding to the predictions.

choices.text: Use Model Monitor to compare the data-quality baseline with inputs in production
choices.explanation: You can check changes in input statistics even without labels.
Changes in the distribution of input features cannot be determined from CPU metrics.

learning.reason: You can check changes in input statistics even without labels.
learning.concept: Data drift and degradation in prediction quality are different. Combine monitoring approaches based on the data that is available for verification.

category: モデルの構築・デプロイ・監視
title: Automating Training and Evaluation
prompt: I want to repeat preprocessing, training, and evaluation, and register only models that meet the criteria. What should I use?

choices.explanation: You can use the evaluation results as conditions to run subsequent model registration.

choices.text: Manage only the version numbers in Model Registry
choices.explanation: This manages models after registration but does not automate preprocessing or training.

choices.text: Auto scaling for an inference endpoint
choices.explanation: This controls inference capacity; it is not a model-evaluation workflow.

learning.reason: You can use the evaluation results as conditions to run subsequent model registration.
learning.concept: Recording the data, training settings, evaluation metrics, and model version makes reproducibility easier to achieve.

category: モデルの構築・デプロイ・監視
title: Large-Scale Overnight Inference
prompt: There are millions of inputs in S3, and I want to run inference on them in batches overnight. A continuously running endpoint is not required. What is appropriate?

choices.explanation: You can run a job on inputs in S3 and save the results to S3.

choices.text: Start a training job for each input
choices.explanation: Only inference is required, so there is no need to retrain the model.

choices.text: Keep a SageMaker real-time endpoint running continuously
choices.explanation: This is suitable for low-latency synchronous responses, but the overnight batch does not require a continuously running resource.

learning.reason: You can run a job on inputs in S3 and save the results to S3.
learning.concept: Choose the inference approach by distinguishing the latency requirements of synchronous APIs from throughput requirements for batch processing.

category: モデルの構築・デプロイ・監視
title: Training and Inference Consistency for Features
prompt: Multiple models use the same features, and I want to keep their definitions consistent during training and online inference. What should I use?

choices.text: Reuse only the input text from CloudWatch Logs
choices.explanation: This does not provide standardized feature definitions or low-latency retrieval.

choices.text: Implement separate calculations in each model's inference code
choices.explanation: This is likely to create differences in formulas or update timing.
It manages shared features that can be used for both online and offline purposes.

learning.reason: It manages shared features that can be used for both online and offline purposes.
learning.concept: The online store and offline store do not serve the same role. Freshness and point-in-time consistency must also be considered in the design.

category: モデルの構築・デプロイ・監視
title: Preventing Future Information Leakage into Training Data
prompt: To predict cancellations in the following month, features that are finalized only after cancellation were included, causing the validation accuracy to become unnaturally high. How should this be corrected?

choices.text: Increase the number of random splits while keeping the same features
choices.explanation: The features still cannot be obtained at inference time.

choices.text: Limit the features to those available at prediction time and evaluate using a time-based split
choices.explanation: This removes future information that cannot be obtained during actual inference.

choices.text: Increase the number of model parameters
choices.explanation: Features containing future information are not removed.

learning.reason: Remove future information that cannot be obtained during actual inference.
learning.concept: Check for data leakage based not only on feature values, but also on when those values became known.

category: モデルの構築・デプロイ・監視
title: Checking for Training-Time Bias
prompt: In classification data, the distribution of positive labels may differ substantially by attribute. How should this be checked before training?

choices.text: Adjust the maximum size of the inference response
choices.explanation: Changing the response format does not reveal dataset trends.

choices.text: Use the pre-training bias metrics in SageMaker Clarify
choices.explanation: These metrics can evaluate attribute-specific trends in the data.

choices.text: Compare the model's production CPU utilization
choices.explanation: This does not evaluate the label distribution in the data.

learning.reason: These metrics can evaluate attribute-specific trends in the data.
learning.concept: Bias in the data and bias appearing in model predictions must be checked at separate stages.
